subject.title: fix(models): strip plaintext api keys from models json

question: Should this PR be rebased/replaced now to cover current root and plugin-owned model catalog writers, or should it remain parked until the PI-removal/new registry path is ready?
rationale: The remaining blockers are security and auth compatibility choices, not a narrow mechanical repair: the fix must choose how to preserve existing auth while preventing prompt-visible persisted secrets across current catalog writers.

options.title: Rebase or replace on current catalog writers
options.body: Update the fix against current main so both root `models.json` and plugin-owned generated catalogs are sanitized, with explicit runtime marker handling and upgrade proof.

options.title: Adopt a broader related branch after proof
options.body: Use a related PR as the landing vehicle only if it becomes cleanly mergeable, proof-positive, and preserves this PR's custom-provider compatibility cases.

options.title: Keep parked for registry direction
options.body: Leave this protected branch open as source material if maintainers want to wait for the post-PI registry path before choosing the permanent auth-storage migration.

recommendation.title: Rebase or replace on current catalog writers
recommendation.body: Update the fix against current main so both root `models.json` and plugin-owned generated catalogs are sanitized, with explicit runtime marker handling and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the maintainer fixup and already commented that this should be picked back up after the PI-removal work.
